working_definition: Tm1 is a narrow-field transmedullary columnar neuron of the adult Drosophila optic lobe. Its cell body lies in the distal cortex of the medulla; it receives postsynaptic input principally in medulla layers M2 and M3 (with bleb-type arborizations in M3 and M9) from lamina monopolar neuron L2, and projects across the second optic chiasma to terminate with a bleb-type presynaptic arbor in lobula layer 1. It is cholinergic, unicolumnar (one cell per optic column), and outputs onto T5 neurons, making it a core component of the OFF motion-detection pathway. It is one of the 13 medulla neurons with mapped connectome data in the Kurmangaliyev 2020 atlas.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary narrow field neuron that terminates in lobula layer 1 with a bleb-type terminal arborization and that has fine arborizations in medulla layer M2 and bleb-type arborizations in M3 and M9 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Takemura et al., 2011). In the medulla, it receives strong synaptic input from lamina monopolar neuron L2 (Takemura et al., 2011; Takemura et al., 2013). It outputs onto T5 neurons (Shinomiya et al., 2019). It is a cholinergic neuron (Varija Raghu et al., 2011; Shinomiya et al., 2014). There is usually one of these cells per optic column (Nern et al., 2025).

justification: The cluster label 'Tm1' directly names a well-characterised anatomical cell type, and FBbt:00003789 is the canonical term for that exact type. The FBbt record (label: 'transmedullary neuron Tm1') is not obsolete and its definition is fully concordant with the cluster description: narrow-field columnar neuron, medulla layers M2/M3/M9, lobula layer 1 bleb-type terminal, cholinergic identity (Cha-GAL4/anti-ChAT, Varija Raghu et al. 2011; Shinomiya et al. 2014), strong L2 input in the medulla (Takemura et al. 2011, 2013), T5 output (Shinomiya et al. 2019), and one cell per optic column. All defining features of the cluster are covered by the FBbt term and the FBbt term introduces no contradictory properties.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: An intrinsic columnar neuron of the optic lobe whose cell body lies in the distal cortex of the medulla and that projects through the medulla and optic chiasm into the lobula. All neurons arborize in the lobula and most, but not all, in the medulla (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Valid parent class of Tm1 but more general; the cluster resolves to the specific named type Tm1 so the parent is redundant as best match.
